reviewer_role: Not this candidate author; earlier cohort and source tooling contributions do not constitute source approval. Current review independently reads originals.
decision: Complete native route and chemistry are supportable with the stated source conventions and limits. Correct the two minor source-provenance defects before integration. No further confirmed scientific or replay-helper defect was found in this bounded review.

observed_evidence.source_assertion: Anr is essential for anaerobic narK1 promoter activity; promoter motif mutation and complementation support the expression effect.

evidence.source_fact: Paragraph 1 reports regulatory mutants and complementation and predicts binding motifs. Paragraph 2 describes the Anr consensus-box nucleotide substitutions and loss of detectable promoter activity.

findings.finding: The assertion includes promoter motif mutation, but its sole locator ends at paragraph 1 and omits the paragraph containing that experiment. The biological assertion is supported by the complete original article.
findings.requested_change: Include paragraph 2 together with paragraph 1 in the exact source locator; update the matching projection and a source-specific regression. Preserve the expression-level scope and biology.

observed_edge.subject: UniProtKB:G3XD60
observed_edge.description: Current entry localization; inferred/rule-based scope remains as in the cited source. Membrane role does not itself demonstrate proton pumping.

evidence.source_assertion: The subcellular-location annotation places the protein in the cell/inner membrane.

findings.finding: The sole cited UniProt comment says Membrane and Multi-pass membrane protein with ECO:0000256 ARBA inference. It does not state cell membrane or inner membrane. The source-local assertion and sole evidence for the more specific GO:0005886 object therefore exceed this selected annotation. This is not evidence that NarK1 lacks a plasma-membrane role.
findings.requested_change: Narrow the UniProt assertion to its actual generic membrane scope. Retain the specific plasma-membrane edge only with separately cited support or an explicitly supported inference under the record contract; otherwise use a source-supported location. Preserve the distinction between annotation, physiological inference and direct localization.

assessments.assessment: Native DENITRIFICATION-PWY contains exactly five listed reactions, including TRANS-RXN0-239. All are represented; the nitrate, nitrite, NO, N2O and N2 chemical sequence is complete. GO/KEGG broader alternatives are not silently substituted. Transport is retained as a formal source-defined antiport object, explicitly not proven as the strict PAO1 mechanism.

Fresh rg -uu --follow scans in original checkout and current 218 included ignored/hidden files, excluding only .git and .venv. Two retained research mentions and ignored DRAM module alternatives were read and distinguished; no maintained exact pathway was found. This is the declared identity/reaction/PMID search, not source exhaustion.

All five native objects, 29 stoichiometric sides and selected left-to-right pathway traversal were independently checked from original XML. RXN-11236 and RXN-15838 reaction records are reversible; native pathway layout selects the represented traversal. Other-species controllers are explicitly excluded rather than transferred.

Seven selected native small compounds match ChEBI InChI/formula/charge in the retained original SQL. Five original-source atom/charge balances and the compartment-aware net pass independently. c551 and generic c-type carriers remain distinct unchanged formal classes; no full protein molecular formula or energetic pumping proof is inferred from balance. Rhea class comparisons retain their broader scope and compartment limits.

All 13 selected current UniProt entries map to PAO1 taxon 208964. Gene deletion/physiology and structural preparations are not upgraded to exact purified current sequences. Original RCSB polymer records identify natural PAO1 but NorB lacks current residue R301 and NorC has K100 versus current N100; both differences remain explicit. E. coli complementation and non-isogenic IHF mutant evidence are bounded.

NarG/H/I and NorB/C are qualified functional ensemble roles, not claims that individual subunits alone catalyze complete reactions. Inspected native complexes belong to other taxa and are not reused as PAO1 assemblies. No unsupported exact transporter-to-antiport enables relation or heterologous complex identity is asserted.

Fe-S, Mo-bisMGD, hemes, copper and calcium assertions preserve current entry evidence codes and structural preparation scope. The 2010 primary Fig. 4 discussion supports exclusion of NorB proton pumping despite a conflicting current similarity annotation. c551 is not promoted to the unique physiological donor for all terminal reductases; azurin is not required by the inspected 1997 abstract. Strict antiport versus uniport remains unresolved.

Expression-level Anr, Dnr and NarL effects are separated from catalysis and iMod context. The Anr source assertion needs Results paragraph 2 for its motif experiment; the NarK1 source-local annotation is generic membrane and does not alone establish the stated cell/inner-membrane specificity. These are the two issue407 findings, not refutations of the pathway.

The complete target, all 75 edges and 155 evidence blocks were read. All local selectors resolve against original bytes, and the sole web-only primary block was independently reopened. The edge-level assessment records each selector and selected payload hash. Resolution is not treated as semantic proof: two resolving selectors nevertheless require source-local corrections. All 72 references and their source versions/access tiers were inspected.

Original full PMC HTML/JATS for 2006 transport, 2007 regulatory, 2009 Nap compensation and 2014/2018 PAO1 physiology was inspected at the cited passages and relevant methods/context. Scanned 1985/1995 items and selected historical structure/biochemistry papers remain abstract-only where stated. The 2010 main paper was independently read through its author-uploaded web text around Fig. 4; there is no local full-main digest or claim that abstract/mmCIF reproduce that discussion.

The unchanged canonical adapter replayed 52 original bodies, including 30 search queries, 16 gene pages and five selected component tables, with three precise411 regulator-null parser errors preserved. Membership does not establish direct regulation, catalysis or exact historical-strain identity, and nonhits/errors are not absence evidence.

An actual unchanged full helper run passed 5 native objects, 29 sides, 5 balances, 23 Rhea class sides and KGX 45 nodes/75 edges/155 evidence, plus seven chemistry controls. A full authentic late metadata mutation was rejected with no success output. Eight isolated original-code binding/exclusive-output controls passed. The first probe fixture failure is preserved and not credited as a pass. Production authority integration and whole-corpus gates are outside this external helper claim.

All declared initial inputs, accepted and rejected acquisition responses, iMod bodies and small handoff artifacts were freshly rehashed unchanged. Original author tuple/list, whitespace-normalization and self-log preparation failures remain preserved. They are not recast as biological defects. No maintained files, source caches or GitHub state were modified by this review.

limitations: No canonical maintained review save: repository helper rejected the external absolute target as designed.
No maintained authority snapshot selection, corpus gate, generated website or browser interaction approval.
Source-defined antiport is a qualified database representation; strict PAO1 antiport/uniport and exact catalyst remain unresolved.
